ceterms:description.en-US: This course continues developing problem solving techniques by focusing on fundamental data structures and associated algorithms. Topics include: abstract data types, introduction to object-oriented programming, linked lists, stacks, queues, hash tables, binary trees, graphs, recursion, and searching and sorting algorithms. Using C++ in a UNIX environment. Corequisite: Lab component. Prerequisite: CSCE 20004 with a C or better, and must be a student in ENGR, ENGRFR, EXPLEN, or CSCE-Minor. (Typically offered: Fall and Spring)

languageModel.name: qwen3.5:9b
languageModel.argument: The sentence begins with 'CSCE 20004', which is a course code, followed by 'with a C or better'. The conjunction 'and' connects the grade requirement to the student status requirement ('must be a student in...'), creating an 'all_of' relationship per the definition of ceterms:requires where multiple conditions must be met. Within the student status clause, the list 'ENGR, ENGRFR, EXPLEN, or CSCE-Minor' uses commas and the word 'or' to indicate that satisfying any single option is sufficient, creating an 'any_of' relationship per the definition of ceterms:alternativeCondition where any one path fulfills the parent condition.
